channel.title: NASA Space Exploration Updates
channel.description: Latest images and exploration updates tracked from nasa.gov

item.title: NASA Sets Crew-13 Launch, Docking Coverage
item.description: Coverage plans for the launch and docking of NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station. Crew: Sergey Teteryatnikov, Luke Delaney, Jessica Watkins and Joshua Kutryk.

item.title: NASA, Boeing Share Update on Commercial Starliner Development Plans
item.description: NASA and Boeing share an update on commercial Starliner development plans. Image: Starliner docked to the Harmony module's forward port.

item.title: NASA Highlights Lessons Learned From Swift Boost Mission
item.description: NASA highlights lessons learned from the Swift observatory boost mission.
